interpretation.label: orienting_valence_gating_non_degenerate

preconditions.name: fresh_orienting_ticks_sufficient
preconditions.description: Genuine (non-latched) orienting ticks observed by the sentinel tap on the ON arm. Below this floor the tap saw too little of the mechanism for any override-derived statistic to mean anything.
preconditions.control: ON arm, gate enabled at shipped SD-099 defaults

preconditions.name: latch_separation_observed
preconditions.description: At least one LATCHED tick must be observed. Zero latched ticks would mean the freshness sentinel is reporting every env step as fresh -- the one tap failure mode that is not self-catching (see experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py), and the exact defect this run exists to remove. It would silently reproduce the 910-lineage inflation.
preconditions.control: ON arm; e3_steps_per_tick defaults to 10, so most ticks are held

preconditions.name: pooled_override_ticks_sufficient
preconditions.description: At least 10 GENUINE Component-4/5 override ticks pooled across ON-arm seeds, counted at the override tick itself. This is the readiness gate for the decisive criterion. NOT comparable to V3-EXQ-910a's floor of 5, which was applied to the inflated per-env-step counter.
preconditions.control: ON arm, gate enabled; the control arm cannot fire an override

interpretation.combination_rule: AND over both load-bearing criteria (C1 instrument-correctness, C2 valence non-degeneracy); a vacuous pass on either forces FAIL.

per_arm_gate.scope_note: orienting_off has no defensive_orienting gate, so n_override_ticks == 0 is forced by construction. It is scoped OUT of criterion scoring (disposition (b)) and retained as a structural negative control; its zero is recorded below, not scored as a criterion it would pass vacuously. Preconditions above are ON-arm only for the same reason.

context_only_not_pass_criteria.note: The trigger-alignment sub-claim (Components 1-3) is NOT re-tested by this run -- see SCOPE. These are reported for continuity with V3-EXQ-910/910a only, and are computed on the LATCHED per-step log exactly as those runs did, so they remain directly comparable to them and are NOT corrected.
